description: Reads a Promise or a Context during render. Not a Hook: it may be called conditionally.
When `use` receives a pending Promise, the component pauses and the nearest `<Suspense>` fallback is shown.
A Promise created outside render (parent, loader, cache) so it is the same object on every render.
React 19.3 `react-dom` API. `use(browser())` suspends during server rendering and resolves in the browser.
